svg.title: Clear turning space
svg.desc: Clear turning circles with diameters 1.5 and 2.5 metres, at the same scale, with a contextual manual wheelchair user outside the circles. Source claims: turning. Neutral tiles and their thickness are display assumptions. Circles represent clear space, not device silhouettes or swept paths. The adjacent manual chair/user (.72 × 1.20 m, 1.35 m seated height) is an illustration assumption.
